overview_pre: This page groups **perineal papules and fold conditions**: anogenital warts in depth, plus short sections on groin hidradenitis and look-alikes.
kf: **Anogenital warts**: HPV 6/11; about 30% regress in months, so no treatment is a valid choice.
Patient-applied: podophyllotoxin or imiquimod per SmPC (avoid podophyllotoxin in pregnancy); clinic: cryotherapy, TCA, excision.
Recurrence is common; offer sexual health screening and HPV vaccination where eligible.
Normal variants to recognise: **pearly penile papules**, Fordyce spots.
Groin HS, molluscum, candidal intertrigo and lichen sclerosus are key differentials.
myths: **"Warts mean a partner was unfaithful"**: incubation can be months to years.
patho_lead: HPV **infects basal keratinocytes** through tiny abrasions.

mech.t: Microabrasions expose basal cells to HPV.
Virus persists in normal-looking skin, causing recurrence.
Follicular occlusion in apocrine folds forms tunnels.

comp: Psychosexual distress, recurrence; rare high-risk HPV dysplasia.
